## Purpose

Turn owner-selected source meaning into durable, typed, source-bound ontology packages that people and machines can validate, inspect, retrieve, evolve, and replace without transferring meaning authority to the Product or runtime.

## Scope

Included:

- A deterministic governed ontology-package contract
- Source-bound typed nodes and relations
- Bounded list and get retrieval
- Generated human projections
- Visible residue and non-collapse obligations

Excluded:

- Ownership of source meaning
- Definition, Context, or runtime admission
- Product approval
- Publication, release, deployment, or source retirement

Private test-candidate Product identity and contract only. It does not admit the Product, prove user value, own source meaning, adopt the runtime, admit contexts, approve the Product, or authorize publication, release, deployment, or source retirement.
